foot.not_advice: It is not medical advice. It cannot diagnose anyone, and the questionnaires and criteria it explains are teaching tools, not tests to use on yourself or your child. Nothing here should change a support plan or a medicine without your own clinician. Criteria, doses and guideline statements are quoted as published. Please check the original sources, which are listed in full in the Sources module.
shell.disclaimer: An educational synthesis of published research for study and understanding. It cannot diagnose autism: only a qualified assessment can, and the questionnaires shown here are teaching tools, not for self-diagnosis. Doses, criteria and guideline statements are reported as published, not as instructions.
shell.note: An animated, cited guide for students, autistic people, families and caregivers. Educational only, not medical advice and not a diagnostic tool. Your place is saved on this device.
